name: Reuse Sections
description: Write a section once and reuse it anywhere: mark it with `&&&` ... `/&&&`, then embed it in any note with `&&&/notebook/note/#section`.
author: madusanka

screenshots.label: Marking a section of a note as shareable with &&& ... /&&&
Typing &&&/ opens a drop-down of notebooks, then notes, then the sections of a note
The section rendered in another note, in another notebook, from a single reference line

promo_tile.label: Reuse Sections - write a section once, embed it in any note
